summary: Backend-only validation of (1) WhatsApp Templates manager endpoints under /api/whatsapp/templates*, (2) WhatsApp Bulk Campaigns under /api/sales/wa/*, and (3) Basic-plan ($29/mo) channel restriction in /api/billing/plans. 25/25 tests pass in new file test_whatsapp_templates_and_sales_wa.py. Meta Graph API success paths were intentionally NOT exercised (no vendor has an ACTIVE WA connection — kamal's connection is status=inactive), so testing focused on the gate/validation/422 error responses as instructed. All requested validation paths return the documented status codes and detail messages.

minor.issue: Channel-access gate (_vendor_can_use_channel for 'whatsapp') is evaluated BEFORE the connection-check (status=='active') in whatsapp_send_template (server.py L2189). For exempt vendor kamal the gate passes, so we still surface the 400 'WhatsApp not connected'. However for a non-exempt Basic-plan vendor the order is fine. Acceptable, just noting that the two other endpoints (list/create/delete) don't run the channel gate at all — they rely purely on the connection check. If a plan ever excludes WhatsApp (none today), a vendor could submit a template without a paywall hit. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py whatsapp_send_template L2189-2191: channel gate runs first; intentional but be aware the create/list/delete endpoints do NOT gate the channel — only the connection check. If you later add a plan that excludes WhatsApp, those endpoints will bypass the gate.

sales_routes.py wa_create_campaign L1141-1148: when no WA connection, returns 400 with detail 'Connect your WhatsApp number in Channels → WhatsApp before launching a campaign.' — friendlier than the generic 'WhatsApp not connected'. Good UX, just diverges from server.py's wording — consider unifying for consistent toast messages on the frontend.

sales_routes.py wa_pause/resume/cancel return 400 for both 'wrong state' AND 'not found' (no separate 404). Frontend cannot distinguish 'campaign was already canceled' from 'campaign doesn't exist'. Minor UX nit — could split into 404 (no match by id+vendor) vs 400 (match but wrong status).
sales_routes.py wa_create_campaign L1166: prospect_filter uses {'list_ids': {'$in': target_list_ids}} which correctly matches prospects in ANY of the selected lists (union). Good.
server.py whatsapp_templates_create L2114: regex {{\s*(\d+)\s*}} correctly extracts placeholder indices; example values padded with 'Sample N' so Meta accepts. Solid.
server.py PLANS L45-54: Basic plan correctly limited to whatsapp/email/web (NO voice/sms) — matches spec. plan_allows_channel returns True for missing/empty plan_key (exempt). Good.
Tests/coverage gap: no test for Basic-plan vendor's allowed_channels because no Basic-plan vendor seeded in DB. _plan_for_vendor flow verified indirectly via exempt vendor returning all 5 channels.
